```sql
WITH hits AS (
    (SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.table_name, a.row_id, a.action, a.old_data,
            a.new_data, a.actor_id, a.is_system, a.created_at
       FROM audit_log a
      WHERE %(table_name)s::text IS NULL
        AND %(row_id)s::uuid IS NULL
        AND a.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
        AND a.created_at >= %(from)s
        AND a.created_at <  %(to)s
      ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
      LIMIT %(limit)s + %(offset)s)
    UNION ALL
    (SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.table_name, a.row_id, a.action, a.old_data,
            a.new_data, a.actor_id, a.is_system, a.created_at
       FROM audit_log a
      WHERE %(table_name)s::text IS NOT NULL
        AND %(row_id)s::uuid IS NULL
        AND a.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
        AND a.table_name = %(table_name)s
        AND a.created_at >= %(from)s
        AND a.created_at <  %(to)s
      ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
      LIMIT %(limit)s + %(offset)s)
    UNION ALL
    (SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.table_name, a.row_id, a.action, a.old_data,
            a.new_data, a.actor_id, a.is_system, a.created_at
       FROM audit_log a
      WHERE %(table_name)s::text IS NULL
        AND %(row_id)s::uuid IS NOT NULL
        AND a.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
        AND a.row_id = %(row_id)s
        AND a.created_at >= %(from)s
        AND a.created_at <  %(to)s
      ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
      LIMIT %(limit)s + %(offset)s)
    UNION ALL
    (SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.table_name, a.row_id, a.action, a.old_data,
            a.new_data, a.actor_id, a.is_system, a.created_at
       FROM audit_log a
      WHERE %(table_name)s::text IS NOT NULL
        AND %(row_id)s::uuid IS NOT NULL
        AND a.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
        AND a.table_name = %(table_name)s
        AND a.row_id = %(row_id)s
        AND a.created_at >= %(from)s
        AND a.created_at <  %(to)s
      ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
      LIMIT %(limit)s + %(offset)s)
)
SELECT h.id,
       h.tenant_id,
       h.table_name,
       h.row_id,
       h.action,
       h.old_data,
       h.new_data,
       h.actor_id,
       h.is_system,
       h.created_at
  FROM hits h
 ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s OFFSET %(offset)s
```

De `(param IS NULL OR kolom = param)`-constructie verhindert dat de planner, vooral bij generieke plannen met server-side binding, een gericht indexpad kiest. Daarom is de query opgesplitst in vier elkaar uitsluitende takken. Door de parametercondities als one-time filter wordt per aanroep maar één tak uitgevoerd, met een eigen indexgeschikt predicaat en een vroege stop via `LIMIT limit+offset`. Een NULL-limit of NULL-offset maakt de binnenste limiet NULL, dus onbeperkt, waardoor het resultaat identiek blijft aan het origineel.
